    possible = list(itertools.combinations(range(21), 2))
    random.shuffle(possible)
    edges = []
    adj = [[] for _ in range(21)]
    for u, v in possible:

        dist = [-1] * 21
        dist[u] = 0
        q = collections.deque([u])
        found = False
